name: voxcpm
description: OpenBMB VoxCPM2 on Strix Halo: multilingual 48 kHz speech synthesis with voice design and voice cloning

releases.notes: Declares two GPU hardware queues (extension API 0.3.24), so `gufo serve tts` decodes audio beside generation without `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES`: 4 to 5 % faster with the Q8_0 file, 3 to 4 % with bfloat16 weights; cloning without a transcript (a preset without one, or `voice_clone_mode: speaker_embedding_only`) works instead of failing with 500. Built on Gufo 0.37.0.
`gufo model install voxcpm2` or `voxcpm2-q8` installs the tested Hugging Face weights or audio.cpp's Q8_0 GGUF (Gufo 0.35.0 or later); synthesis unchanged from 0.1.0. Built on Gufo 0.35.0.
Speech synthesis from the Hugging Face directory or audio.cpp's GGUFs (Q8_0 products on the matrix cores): automatic voice, voice design and voice cloning. Built on Gufo 0.34.0.
